# Steady-state benchmark for the `GOW` network (Gong, Ostriker & Wolfire 2017).
#
# Produced with Munan Gong's PDR code using the parameter set of Gong+2017,
# and used here as the reference any JAFF-generated GOW right-hand side is
# compared against.
#
# Conditions:
#   FUV field         chi   = 0.1     (Draine units)
#   metallicity       Z     = 1       (solar)
#   dust-to-gas ratio d2g   = 0.01    (solar)
#   cosmic-ray rate   zeta  = 2e-16   s^-1
#   visual extinction Av    = 0
#   redshift          z     = 0
#
# Each row is a thermal- and chemical-equilibrium state at fixed total hydrogen
# number density nH. Temperature is solved together with the chemistry, not
# imposed. The nH grid is logarithmic, 95 points from 10 to 981.28 cm^-3, and is
# identical in the chi = 0.1, 1 and 10 tables.
#
# Columns: nH [cm^-3], Tgas [K], then abundances relative to total hydrogen
# nuclei, x_i = n_i / nH. Species names carry `p` for a positive charge
# (Cp = C+, HCOp = HCO+, ...); `e` is the free-electron abundance.
#
# NOTE: column `2H2` is 2 * x(H2), i.e. the fraction of hydrogen nuclei locked
# in H2 -- divide by 2 to recover x(H2).
#
# NOTE: a few entries of very rare species may be slightly negative (of order
# 1e-18). That is numerical noise in the reference solver, not a physical
# value; treat any |x| below ~1e-17 as zero when comparing.
#
# nH                    Tgas                      CO                       C                      Cp                    HCOp                      OH                      CH                       O                      Op                     2H2                      Hp                     H2p                     H3p                     Hep                     Sip                       e
